svg.text: Head motion vs. Stage-3 respiration quality
band-limited Pearson (0.1-0.6 Hz) against in-band head-motion RMS (band_rms, face radii) · 5-fold CV, 1260 sessions

Squares = per-task medians. Red line = quintile medians within T3. A monotone decline is visible across tasks; inside T3 it is flat, because T3 has almost no head motion (median band_rms 0.018 vs 0.046-0.10 elsewhere).
